subject.title: [Bug]: Native Talk button triggers OpenAI Realtime WebRTC call and fails with 500 when Realtime is not configured

question: Should Control UI browser Talk start from implicit OpenAI/Codex Realtime credential availability, or only after an explicit Gateway readiness/preflight says Realtime is usable for this session?
rationale: The code already has catalog readiness metadata, but recent merged auth work intentionally changed whether OAuth/Codex credentials can satisfy OpenAI Realtime, so automation should not choose the product contract alone.

options.title: Gate On Gateway Readiness
options.body: Use talk.catalog or an equivalent Gateway preflight to disable or block browser Talk before microphone startup unless the selected Realtime provider is ready, with actionable setup copy.

options.title: Keep Implicit Activation
options.body: Allow OAuth/Codex or other available credentials to make browser Talk available, but improve diagnostics for provider failures instead of disabling the button up front.

options.title: Require Explicit Realtime Config
options.body: Make browser Talk require explicit talk.realtime or provider configuration so local-TTS users never enter OpenAI Realtime accidentally.

recommendation.title: Gate On Gateway Readiness
recommendation.body: Use talk.catalog or an equivalent Gateway preflight to disable or block browser Talk before microphone startup unless the selected Realtime provider is ready, with actionable setup copy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the latest merged OpenAI Realtime OAuth/Codex contract change that determines whether implicit credentials should enable this path.
